title: Declare token budget constraint and defer heavy work when context is low
body: If approaching the end of your context window mid-task, do not start a large commit, generation run, or multi-file change. Stop, declare the budget constraint, and hand off remaining work explicitly. Dropping work silently is worse than stopping early.
source_ref: rules.md:R16; corrections — 11 token-awareness instances; 'Codi is low on tokens, I don't want her to run out mid commit'
